description: Turn a project you designed (planter, shelf, desk, raised bed, fence, patio, painted room, pipe rack) into exact numbers and a blueprint page. Works for boards, pipe, tube, sheets, and materials bought by area, volume or count. You design it, choose materials and estimate prices yourself (search the web if you can); send every piece with its real size in inches and, for the drawing, where it sits. divux returns what to buy, where to cut each board or sheet (saw blade included), size mistakes to fix (a 2x4 is really 1.5 x 3.5 in), and a link to a page with the drawing, cut diagrams and buy list. Every piece needs its position ('at'), so the page can draw it: without positions there is no drawing, 3D view or blueprint views. Send 'search' wording for lumber, glue and hardware so live prices find the right product. Don't guess what the user cares about: if board lengths, wood type or sheet sizes matter, ask which their store sells, and send them as stock. Whatever isn't sent, divux assumes and lists first under Assumed; tell the user those assumptions. For a cedar fence-picket planter, send picket_planter and leave parts out. Divux builds the pieces: dog-ear pickets about 5/8 in by 5 1/2 in by 6 ft, long sides 1 1/2 in shorter than the outside length, ends and floor 1 1/2 in shorter than the outside width, width rounded to whole pickets, L-shaped corner legs ripped to 2 3/8 in (the 1/2 in offcut is the ledger), a center leg when the box is over 4 ft, a connector on a 3-course box of 4 ft or shorter, a ripped floor filler, and 45 degree top trim. Changing length, width, courses or leg_below rebuilds the cuts, the buy count and the 3D view. Presets: a 4 ft by 1 ft low box is length 48, width 12, courses 3, leg_below 1. A 5 ft raised box is length 60, width 18, courses 2, leg_below 6.5. A 3 ft tall box is length 36, width 18, courses 2, leg_below 20. For anything else (a shelf, a desk, a fence, a bed), send every piece in parts, each with its position in at, and the 3D view follows those pieces. A box still needs corner legs (a strip down each corner, or two forming an L), ledger strips under the floor, a center leg or brace when a side is over 4 ft, a ripped filler for the last floor board, and trim so the board ends don't show. It doesn't look up store prices; when the user wants to buy an item, use search_products and compare_prices for it.

extras.description: Screws, nails, glue, finish, and tools needed

price_estimate.description: Your estimate in USD for one (for a tool, the tool)

search.description: What to type into a store search, e.g. 'Titebond III exterior wood glue' or 'exterior deck screws 2.5 inch'. Send it for glue, finish and hardware so the live prices show the right product.

kerf.description: Saw blade width in inches; if left out, divux assumes 1/8 inch and says so under Assumed

parts.description: Every piece, for anything other than a cedar picket planter. Leave this out when picket_planter is set. If both are sent, picket_planter is used.

at.description: Required. Where each copy sits: its lowest corner [x, y, z] in inches, x across, y front to back, z up. size is in the same axes (x, y, z). Without positions there is no drawing, no 3D view and no blueprint views. One entry per copy. Example, a 24 x 12 in planter 11.25 in tall: front [0,0,0], back [0,11.25,0], left [0,0.75,0], right [23.25,0.75,0].

qty.description: Not needed: copies are counted from 'at'

search.description: What to type into a store search for this material, e.g. 'cedar fence picket 6 ft' or '1x6x8 cedar board'. Send it when the default wording may not find the right lumber.

size.description: Real size in inches along width (x), depth (y), height (z)

step.description: Assembly step (1-based) this piece goes on in, matching 'steps'

picket_planter.description: Cedar fence-picket planter. When set, Divux designs the pieces. For any other project, omit this and send parts.

courses.description: How many pickets high the walls are. 3 for the low 4 ft box, 2 for the raised and tall boxes.

leg_below.description: How far the legs stick out below the walls, in inches. 1 for the low box, 6.5 for the raised box, 20 for the tall box.

length.description: Outside length in inches. 36 for a 3 ft box, 48 for 4 ft, 60 for 5 ft. Not rounded.

width.description: Outside width in inches. Rounded to whole 5 1/2 in pickets: 12 becomes 11, 18 becomes 16 1/2.

quantities.description: Materials bought by area, volume or count: paint, stain, tile, flooring, fabric, soil, mulch, gravel, concrete

amount.description: Square feet, cubic feet or pieces, when dims don't fit

dims.description: Inches: [length, width] for area, [length, width, depth] for volume

per_unit.description: What one unit covers (sq ft, cu ft or pieces), e.g. 350 for a gallon of paint, 0.6 for an 80 lb concrete bag

price_estimate.description: Your estimate in USD for one unit

times.description: Repeat the dims, e.g. 2 coats or 4 walls

waste_pct.description: Extra to buy; default 10 for area, 5 for volume, 0 for count

steps.description: Assembly steps in order; pieces refer to them with 'step'

stock.description: Board lengths or sheets you'd buy, with your price estimates. Without it, divux uses common US store lengths and shows no prices.

length.description: Board length, or sheet length, in inches

price_estimate.description: Your estimate in USD for one

title.description: Project name, e.g. 'Cedar planter 24 x 12 in'

units.description: Units for the reply text; imperial (inches) if left out. The plan page has its own switch.
